text.hi: किताब: एक रिपोर्टर ज़िला परीक्षा में पहले आए दीपक का इंटरव्यू लेता है। Tinku रिपोर्टर है, तुम दीपक हो।
text.hinglish: Kitaab: ek reporter zila pariksha mein pehle aaye Deepak ka interview leta hai. Tinku reporter hai, tum Deepak ho.
text.en: The book: a reporter interviews Deepak, who came first in the district exam. Tinku is the reporter; you are Deepak.

turns.tinku: Congratulations, Deepak! I am from the Daily Times.

meaning.hi: बधाई हो दीपक! मैं डेली टाइम्स से हूँ।
meaning.hinglish: Badhaai ho Deepak! Main Daily Times se hoon.

replies.say: Thank you, Sir. Please have a seat.

turns.tinku: How many hours did you study every day?

meaning.hi: तुम रोज़ कितने घंटे पढ़ते थे?
meaning.hinglish: Tum roz kitne ghante padhte the?

replies.say: I studied for five hours every day.

meaning.hi: मैं रोज़ पाँच घंटे पढ़ता था।
meaning.hinglish: Main roz paanch ghante padhta tha.

turns.tinku: Who would you like to give the credit to?

meaning.hi: इस सफलता का श्रेय किसे दोगे?
meaning.hinglish: Is safalta ka shrey kise doge?

replies.say: I give the credit to my parents and teachers.

meaning.hi: मैं श्रेय माता-पिता और शिक्षकों को देता हूँ।
meaning.hinglish: Main shrey maata-pita aur shikshakon ko deta hoon.

turns.tinku: What do you want to become?

replies.say: I want to become an astronaut.

meaning.hi: मैं अंतरिक्ष यात्री बनना चाहता हूँ।
meaning.hinglish: Main antariksh yaatri banna chahta hoon.
